vision: Titanul din Cuburi (Titan of Cubes): a voxel titan walks toward your wall, and you choose which color cannon to send and when. Every cut is a decision, every titan you bring down ends in a physics avalanche, and every loss is visibly your own fault, so you know how to fix it next run. The game pairs Pixel Flow-quality slot-pressure puzzling with a crumbling titan as the differentiator. Hard titans are always honestly beatable. Ads are opt-in gifts offered at the moment of need, plus rare between-run interstitials. There is no shop.
pillars: Fair and readable: every loss is telegraphed and explainable, with no hidden director, no difficulty that depends on ad history, and no rigged draws. Any tuning must pass the simulator with ad helpers turned off.
Earned spectacle: limbs and heads fall only when the player sends the joint color. The cut is the core skill, the main reward and the ad-creative money shot.

One more run: 10-40 s titans in 5-titan cycles that alternate tension and release (WARM/BUILD/PUSH/SPRINT/BOSS), restart in under a second, free checkpoints at cycle starts, and a reason to come back every day (Titanul Zilei plus a forgiving streak).

Ads are a gift, not a tax: rewarded ads are opt-in with real, previewed value at peak need and rare by design. Interstitials appear only between runs, can be turned off for 30 min with one ad, never interrupt play, and there is no banner.

backlog.title: Salvage: severed pieces take their ammo with them (dead-ammo fix)
backlog.spec:
CORE (Assets/Titan/Scripts/Core)

1) Monster keeps int[] colorCount (length MonsterBuilder.MaxColors).
- Update it in Set (if a cube is replaced, decrement the old color), in Remove, and in DropUnsupported (decrement per dropped cube).
- CountOfColor(c) is O(1).

2) New EventKind.Salvaged. GameEvent gets a new int Ammo field. Also uses Slot (line index or -1), TraySlot (tray index or -1), Color and Points.

3) Private TitanGame.Salvage(). Call it (a) at the end of Shoot() when pieces.Count > 0, and (b) at the top of CheckSlotsFull(). Steps:
  i) For each line slot with a cannon whose color has CountOfColor == 0:
     - points = Ammo * PointsPerSalvagedAmmo
     - Score += points
     - emit Salvaged{Slot=s, Color, Ammo, Points}
     - Line[s] = null
  ii) For each color: surplus = (deck ammo + tray ammo) - CountOfColor. If surplus > 0, subtract it from deck cannons of that color in ascending Ammo order, removing any that reach 0. No event, no points.
  iii) Any surplus still left comes off tray cannons of that color, index 0..2:
     - Subtract and emit Salvaged{TraySlot=i, Ammo=taken, Points=taken*5}.
     - If Ammo reaches 0, set Tray[i] = null.
  iv) If the tray is now all null, RefillTray(). Under CORE-3 PerSlot, refill each nulled slot instead.

4) INVARIANT, after every Tick:
- No line cannon's color has a count of 0.
- For every color, deck + tray ammo <= CountOfColor.
- At spawn, ammo == cubes (the existing test stays).

VIEW (ArenaView/GameController)
- Salvaged on a line slot: the cannon spins 360 degrees on Y and flies up 6 units over 0.35 s, then is destroyed. Popup 'RECUPERAT +{Points}'.
- Salvaged on a tray slot: a '-{Ammo}' label in the color flies from the fallen piece's centroid to the tray cannon over 0.3 s, then the ammo label lerps to its new value over 0.3 s. If the ammo reaches 0, play the existing ShrinkAway (0.25 s).
- Sound: deploy sound at pitch 1.5.
- These animations are mandatory, not polish: a silently dropping number reads as cheating.

HUD: GameController.AmmoTag must keep 'zzz' only for cannons whose color still exists. With salvage, dead cannons cannot exist on the line.

SHIP GATE: expose public bool SalvageActive => Config.SalvageEnabled. ADS-2 placements check it (see ADS-2).

backlog.title: Earned cuts: farthest-first targeting, unified part-tag API, honest 'TAIE!' tag
backlog.spec:
CORE

1) Part tags, the single API used by every later system. In Monster:
- Dictionary<Int3,byte> part (0 body, 1 left arm, 2 right arm, 3 head; 4+ reserved).
- HashSet<Int3> joints (shoulder and neck cubes).
- int[] originalPartSize, recorded at build time.
- Public: int PartOf(Int3), bool IsJoint(Int3), int OriginalPartSize(int part), int RemainingPartSize(int part) (kept up to date in Remove/DropUnsupported).
- MonsterBuilder fills these.
- FallenPiece gains int Part = the majority PartOf over its cubes (head wins ties).

2) supportDist: Dictionary<Int3,int> computed lazily by multi-source BFS over face neighbours from all anchored cubes (anchored = 0). Invalidate it (set to null) in Remove and DropUnsupported. Cache it; never recompute per PickTarget call within the same removal epoch.

3) TitanConfig.TargetOrder enum {HighestFirst, FarthestFirst}, default FarthestFirst. It is passed to Monster at spawn. Monster.PickTarget(color, cannonX), among VISIBLE cubes of that color, orders by:
   (1) max supportDist when FarthestFirst
   (2) max Y
   (3) min |X - cannonX|
   (4) min X

4) MonsterBuilder: hand = arm color (remove the separate hand pick). Arm cubes on the bottom row are stored in HashSet<Int3> gloves, for the view only (shape cue, NOT a darker tint).

5) Cut prediction: public int ShotsToSever(Cannon c). Clone the Monster's color set, simulate PickTarget/Remove for c.Ammo shots of c.Color with no other cannons, and return the shot index at which a piece containing a joint's part falls, or -1. Results are cached per (tray slot, monster epoch).

VIEW
- Joint cubes get a child stripe: a cube primitive scaled (1.04, 0.14, 1.04) at local y 0, plain white material. This is the 'cusătură' (stitch).
- Glove cubes get a 0.9-scale inset child cube of the same color with edge lines. Never change cube luminance.

HUD
- Above each tray cannon where ShotsToSever >= 0, draw a yellow 'TAIE!' tag (fontSize 18*s, rect 64x22*s, 4*s above the ammo tag), with alpha pulsing 0.7-1.0 at 3 Hz.
- If the cannon's color owns a visible joint but ShotsToSever == -1, draw a hollow 'taie în N' hint only when another cannon of that color is in the tray or on the line. Otherwise draw nothing.

TESTS
- LimbCannonNeverSeversLimb: for 50 seeds at levels 1, 4 and 7, take the arm color; repeatedly Remove(PickTarget(armColor)) while it succeeds and assert no piece ever falls.
- JointCutDropsWholeArm: arm count includes gloves.
- Update TargetIsTheHighestVisibleCube to set TargetOrder=HighestFirst.
- TaieTagIsHonest: for 100 seeds, any tray cannon with ShotsToSever >= 0, deployed alone on an empty line with no other cannons, severs a piece within its ammo.
- Part API: OriginalPartSize(left arm) == count of part-1 cubes at build; RemainingPartSize decreases on Remove.

README: update the targeting rule and the combo rule.

Tools/Sim (preset with salvage + FarthestFirst): share of pieces attributed to a joint shot >= 60% for all bots (was 31-38%); pieces per titan 2.5-3.5; median run length not lower than the CORE-1 result minus 10%.
No 'TAIE!' tag appears on a cannon that cannot reach the joint (TaieTagIsHonest).
PickTarget performance: 1000 calls on a level-8 monster in under 50 ms in a dotnet test (BFS cached).

backlog.title: Loop v2: conveyor tray + titan clock (knockback, near-miss) + 5-titan sawtooth cycles, tuned together
backlog.spec:
Ship these three together under one preset. Never ship the per-slot tray without the clock: the harness showed Smart hitting the 30-min cap in 98% of games.

A) CONVEYOR TRAY
- TitanConfig.TrayRefill enum {Batch, PerSlot}, default PerSlot; NoTripleColor = true.
- Deploy in PerSlot mode: Tray[traySlot] = Draw(); emit TrayRefilled{TraySlot=traySlot} (TraySlot = -1 keeps the old all-slots meaning).
- Draw, after the unchanged bias logic: if NoTripleColor and the two other non-null tray cannons share color X and the drawn color == X, pick uniformly (rng) among deck cannons with Color != X, if any exist.
- After CORE-1 salvage nulls a tray slot, Draw into it.
- An empty deck leaves a null slot, drawn as a dark ring labelled 'pachet gol'.
- View: the new cannon rises from 2.5 units below its tray position over 0.18 s; deploy sound at pitch 1.2, volume 0.35.

B) TITAN CLOCK
- Approach(n, cubes) = max(MinApproachSeconds, (ApproachBaseSeconds + perCube*cubes) * max(MinApproachFactor, ApproachSpeedup^(n-1))).
- perCube = TutorialSecondsPerCube when n <= TutorialTitans, else ApproachSecondsPerCube.
- Knockback in Shoot, for each FallenPiece p:
  - back = clamp(p.Count*KnockbackPerCube, KnockbackMin, KnockbackMax)
  - Distance = min(StartDistance, Distance + back)
  - stepTimer -= min(StunMax, StunBase + StunPerCube*p.Count)
  - emit EventKind.Staggered{Distance, Piece}
- DefeatTitan: if Distance <= NearMissFraction*StartDistance, bonus = round(bonus*NearMissBonusMult) and GameEvent.NearMiss = true.
- View, Staggered: the titan root lerps to its new Z over 0.3 s with a 10-degree back-lean (ease out); Roar if piece >= 20 cubes; Shake(0.15, 0.25).
- View, NearMiss: gold banner 'LA MUSTAȚĂ!  x1.5' for 1.6 s; fanfare at pitch 1.15.
- Danger = 1 - Distance/StartDistance. At >= 0.75:
  - procedural heartbeat: two 55 Hz thumps 0.12 s apart every 0.8 s, volume 0.4 rising to 0.7 at 0.95
  - red border made of 4 rects (6% of screen width), alpha 0.12 + 0.13*sin(t*8). Pulse <= 3 Hz.
  - Under the 'Efecte reduse' setting (UX-1), the border is static.

C) CYCLES (UseCycles = true). In SpawnTitan(n): c = (n-1)/5, p = (n-1)%5, then:
- p0 WARM: L = min(1+c, 5)
- p1 BUILD: L = min(2+c, 6)
- p2 PUSH: L = min(3+c, 6)
- p3 SPRINT: L = (c >= 2 ? 2 : 1)
- p4 BOSS: L = min(4+c, 8)
Monster = MonsterBuilder.Build(L, rng). Level stays n.
- Public enum TitanRole {Normal, Sprint, Boss}; TitanGame.Role; GameEvent.Role on TitanSpawned.
- Defeat bonus = DefeatBonusPerLevel * n * (Boss ? 2 : 1) * nearMiss, plus leftover as today.
- BossExtraColor flag, default false (not validated).
- View on spawn:
  - Sprint: green 'TITAN RAPID!' banner for 1.2 s; deploy sound at pitch 1.4.
  - Boss: red 'TITAN GIGANT!' banner for 1.8 s; Roar; Shake(0.3, 0.6).
- HUD under the score: 'Ciclul {c+1} · Titanul #{n}' plus 5 cycle dots, filled when cleared; dot 5 carries a crown glyph drawn as a texture.
- NOTHING ad-related happens between titans.

D) TUNING PASS (part of this item)
- Use Tools/Sim with --set to search ApproachSecondsPerCube in [0.075, 0.095], TutorialSecondsPerCube in [0.10, 0.14] and ApproachSpeedup in {0.98, 0.985}, keeping the knockback values.
- Choose the combination that best meets the targets in the acceptance criteria.
- Measured starting point (out_C1): Random wall share 71% (too high), runs <20 s 7%, Smart:Random 1.74x.
- Record the chosen values in TitanConfig and in DESIGN.md 4.3.

TESTS

- 500 seeded draws never produce 3 non-null tray cannons of one color when the deck held another color.
- TrayRefillsWhenAllThreeAreUsed is updated to set Batch.

backlog.title: Readable threat: last-slot guard, honest deadlock, slot pips, hidden-color chip
backlog.spec:
CORE

1) public enum DeployBlockReason {None, LineFull, WouldJam, NotAvailable}; public DeployBlockReason DeployBlock(int traySlot).
- WouldJam is true when ALL of these hold:
  - exactly one line slot is free
  - every non-null line cannon has no visible cube of its color
  - the tray cannon has no visible cube of its color
- CanDeploy returns DeployBlock == None.

2) Deadlock. float stuckTimer, updated in Tick after cannons fire.
- stuck = (no line cannon has a visible color) AND (free slots == 0 OR (free == 1 AND no tray cannon has a visible color)).
- free >= 2 is never stuck.
- If stuck, stuckTimer += dt; otherwise reset it to 0.
- At stuckTimer >= DeadlockSeconds: Lose(LoseReason.Deadlock) (new enum value).
- The existing all-5-idle CheckSlotsFull stays immediate.

3) Expose int[] VisibleCountByColor() (cached per frame by the caller) and int HiddenOnlyColorCount() = colors with CountOfColor > 0 and 0 visible.

HUD

backlog.title: Cut scoring (clean cut + chain) and end-of-titan 3-star grade, one multiplier model
backlog.spec:
Requires the CORE-2 part API. This is the ONLY in-titan multiplier system; R6's separate 'Lanț Perfect' is not built.

CORE
- TitanGame tracks float gameTime, float lastPieceTime and int chain.
- On each FallenPiece p in Shoot:
  - part = p.Part
  - clean = p.Count >= CleanCutThreshold * OriginalPartSize(part)
  - chain = (gameTime - lastPieceTime <= ChainWindowSeconds) ? chain+1 : 1; lastPieceTime = gameTime
  - mult = (clean ? CleanCutMult : 1) * min(chain, ChainMaxMult)
  - points = p.Count * PointsPerFallenCube * mult
  - GameEvent fields: bool Clean, int Chain, int Part
- chain resets on TitanSpawned.
- Run stats: maxPiecePoints, maxChain, piecesCut, headsCut.
- Expose bool IsCleanEligible(part) = RemainingPartSize(part) >= CleanCutThreshold * OriginalPartSize(part) && part attached. The view uses it.

STARS on DefeatTitan (GameEvent.Stars bitmask):
- s1 = defeated
- s2 = a clean head piece fell this titan ('Decapitare')
- s3 = maxOccupiedLine <= CleanLineMax ('Linie curată'), where maxOccupied is tracked over all ticks and deploys
- The stars add NO extra multiplier.

VIEW / HUD
- The joint stitch gets a gold rim while IsCleanEligible(part).
- The chain window is a draining arc next to the score while gameTime - lastPieceTime < 4 s.
- Piece popup, stacked lines:
  - clean head: 'DECAPITARE!'
  - clean otherwise: 'TĂIETURĂ CURATĂ!'
  - not clean: 'BUCATĂ RUPTĂ!'
  - if chain >= 2: 'COMBO x{chain}'
  - then '+{points}'
  - scale 1 + 0.15*(chain-1), capped at 1.6; gold when mult >= 4
- Popup priority: one big popup at a time; newer ones queue at most 0.3 s, otherwise merge into the current one.
- Defeat banner: 3 star glyphs (textures) popping in at 0.15 s intervals with rising pitch ticks. A missing star is grey with a one-line reason: 'Capul nu a căzut întreg' or 'Ai avut {k} tunuri pe zid'.
- Live 3-dot indicator under the danger bar; the third dot turns grey the moment maxOccupied > CleanLineMax.
- Game-over panel: 'Cea mai bună tăietură: +{maxPiecePoints}', 'Combo maxim: x{maxChain}'.

BEST SCORE KEY: titan_best_v2 (the old key is ignored for comparison and kept only for migration display).

TUNING: in Tools/Sim, choose CleanLineMax (3 or 4) so that Smart earns s3 on 25-40% of titans and the wall-loss share does not rise by more than 5 points. Add clean-cut and star stats to the report.

TESTS
- An intact arm cut gives clean x2.
- An arm eroded below 80% is not clean.
- Chain increments within 4 s and resets after.
- Chain caps at x5.
- Stars bitmask for scripted scenarios: a neck-only cut gives s2; <= 3 cannons gives s3.

backlog.title: Juice pass (hitstop, camera punch, pitch streak, haptics) + mobile performance budget
backlog.spec:
JUICE (no gameplay change; the finisher collapse is deferred)

1) GameController.HitStop(seconds, scale), unscaled.
- Calls never stack; take the max remaining.
- Hard cap: total freeze <= 10% of any rolling 1 s.
- Disabled under Efecte reduse.
- Time.timeScale returns to 1 on pause and on game over.

2) Triggers:
- PieceFell with size >= 12: HitStop(0.08, 0.05) plus FOV -3% returning over 0.25 s.
- Head piece or clean cut >= 40 cubes: HitStop(0.06, 0.05) then timeScale 0.35 for at most 0.15 s unscaled.
- No slow-mo of any kind when danger >= 0.85 (last 15% of the approach).
- TitanDefeated: HitStop(0.12, 0.05).

3) Audio: a dedicated hit AudioSource.
- Per line slot, a hitStreak that resets after 0.5 s without a hit.
- pitch = min(1.6, 1 + 0.04*hitStreak).

4) Haptics: #if UNITY_ANDROID || UNITY_IOS Handheld.Vibrate() #endif
- Only on: pieces >= 40 cubes, boss defeat, near-miss win.
- Min interval 0.6 s; respects the Vibrații setting.

PERFORMANCE BUDGET
5) Dev overlay (F8 in the editor, or a 3-finger long-press on device): fps, p95 frame ms over the last 300 frames, active GameObjects, active rigidbodies.

6) Pool projectiles and popups (no Instantiate per shot).

7) A fallen piece is one Rigidbody parent with child cubes. If the piece has > 60 cubes, combine the children into one mesh per color (Mesh.CombineMeshes) on fall.

8) Target: 60 fps. Floor: p95 frame <= 33 ms on a 2022 mid-range Android, during a level-8 boss with 3 pieces falling.
- If the floor is missed, combine the anchored body into per-color meshes, rebuilt at most once per frame when dirty.
- Record the measured numbers in DESIGN.md section 7.

9) Log fps_p95 per run to the RET-1 log (event perf, a=p95 ms, b=titan level).

backlog.title: Slim profile + local telemetry + free seeded checkpoints at cycle starts
backlog.spec:
Merges proposals R1 (slim), C11 and R8. Checkpoints are FREE and never ad-gated.

PROFILE
Core/Profile.cs: pure C#, [Serializable], public fields only. v1 fields:
- int version = 1
- int bestScore (v2 key semantics)
- int bestTitanN
- int totalRuns
- float totalPlaySeconds
- int ftueFlags
- Checkpoint {int n; int score; long runSeed}
- Settings {bool sfx, haptics, reducedFx, colorSymbols; string lang}
- int firstPlayDay, lastPlayDay, maxSeenDay
- List<LogEntry> log {long t; string e; int a; int b}, a ring of 300
Add fields only when their feature ships (RET-3 and ADS-1 append theirs).

Core/DayClock.cs
- DayNumber(local) = (local.Date - 2026-01-01).Days.
- Rollback guard: today = max(DayNumber(now), maxSeenDay - 1); then maxSeenDay = max(maxSeenDay, today).
- LOCAL day everywhere (ads included).

Game/ProfileStore.cs
- ISerializer, with a JsonUtility implementation in Game.
- Load order: persistentDataPath/titan_profile.json, then PlayerPrefs 'titan_profile_v1', then new. A new profile migrates 'titan_best' into a displayed legacy best.
- On parse failure, fall back to the next source and log 'save_corrupt'.
- Save: write to .tmp, File.Copy over the final file, delete .tmp, mirror to PlayerPrefs, PlayerPrefs.Save().
- Save on: TitanDefeated, GameOver, checkpoint, settings change, OnApplicationPause(true), OnApplicationQuit. Never per frame.

TELEMETRY
- interface IAnalyticsSink {void Track(string e, int a, int b);} with a NullSink plus the profile log ring.
- Events:
  - session_start(day, daysSinceLast)
  - ftue(step)
  - run_start(startTitan, mode: 0 endless, 1 daily official, 2 daily practice, 3 checkpoint)
  - titan_spawn(n, role)
  - titan_defeat(n, seconds)
  - run_end(n, reason)
  - perf(p95ms, n)
  - restart_ms(ms)
- Debug export: F9 in the editor, or a 3-finger tap on the score, copies the log JSON to GUIUtility.systemCopyBuffer and shows the banner 'Jurnal copiat'. Gameplay events only; no device identifiers.

SEEDED RUNS
- TitanGame(TitanConfig, long runSeed, int startTitan = 1, int startScore = 0).
- SpawnTitan(n) creates rng = new SeededRandom(SeededRandom.Derive(runSeed, n)) and uses it for Build, BuildDeck and every Draw during that titan.
- Keep the old IRandom ctor for tests.

CHECKPOINTS
- On TitanSpawned with n > 1 and (n-1) % 5 == 0 (n = 6, 11, 16...): save Checkpoint {n, Score at that moment, runSeed}, Save(), and show the toast 'Punct de salvare: titanul #{n}' for 1.2 s.
- Game-over panel buttons, in order:
  - 'Joacă din nou': same start as this run; new seed if it started at 1; the checkpoint seed if it was a checkpoint run.
  - 'Reia ciclul (titanul #{n})': only if a checkpoint exists. new TitanGame(cfg, savedSeed, n, savedScore).
  - 'Joc nou': new random seed; the checkpoint is cleared.
- APP LAUNCH, only when totalRuns >= 3 and a checkpoint exists: a minimal overlay with 'Continuă (titanul #{n})' (primary, default focus) and 'Joc nou'. Otherwise start the game immediately.
- Copy says 'același titan' (never 'identic').
acceptance_criteria: Core test: the same runSeed and the same scripted tap sequence give an identical Score and Level after 120 s simulated.
Core test: a checkpoint is saved exactly at n = 6, 11, 16 and never at other n.
Core test: restarting from a checkpoint reproduces titan n's cube layout exactly (cube-by-cube equality).
Core test: the score restored from a checkpoint equals the snapshot (no farming).
Core tests: DayClock rollback (clock moved back 3 days gives no new day); the ring buffer caps at 300; migration from a legacy best value.
Killing the editor play session mid-write leaves a loadable profile (temp-file path test in an editor test, or a manual check documented).
No checkpoint path references any ad API (code review plus a grep test).

CORE (Core/Ads; pure C#)
- AdConfig: public fields; defaults below; overrides from a JSON string passed in by Game, read from Resources/ad_config.json if present.
- AdState: keys persisted through IStore.
- AdGovernor(AdConfig, IClock, IStore).
- enum Placement {ReviveSecondWind, ExtraSlot, AdBreak, InterRunEnd}. Only these ship.
- OfferContext: lifetimeRuns, lifetimePlaySec, sessionIndex, runSeconds, isDailyRanked, revivesUsedThisRun, helpsUsedThisRun, helpUsedThisTitan, titanLevel, progressFraction, titansThisRun, salvageActive.
- Methods: CanOffer(p, ctx, out reason); OnOfferShown; OnOfferDeclined; OnRewardGranted (sets lastRewardedUtc = now and playSinceInter = 0); ShouldShowInterstitial(InterContext, out skipReason); OnInterstitialShown; OnRunStarted; OnRunEnded(sec); OnSessionStarted; AddPlaySeconds(dt).
- A session starts at launch, or on resume after >= 1800 s in the background.
- GLOBAL GATE: any offer or interstitial requires lifetimeRuns >= 3 AND lifetimePlaySec >= 600, and !isDailyRanked.
- ONE-SURFACE RULE: Governor.ActiveSurface; at most one ad offer visible per screen. Priority: Revive > AdBreak proactive.

INTERSTITIAL
InterstitialGate.TryShow(ctx, onDone) is the single call site. Call it only when the player taps 'Joacă din nou', 'Reia ciclul' or 'Joc nou' on the results panel. Skip with the first failing reason (17 rules):
1. inter_enabled
2. sessionIndex >= 2
3. lifetimeRuns >= grace_runs
4. lifetimePlaySec >= 600
5. not in an ad-break pass
6. now - lastInter >= cooldown_s
7. playSinceInter >= min_play_s
8. now - lastRewarded >= 180
9. runSeconds >= 45
10. revive not declined at this game over
11. gameoversThisSession >= 2
12. session count < 5
13. day count < 15
14. results visible >= 1.5 s
15. no new record or new furthest titan in this run
16. not daily ranked
17. ready within 1.0 s, else 'no_fill'

Presets (inter_preset):
- light (DEFAULT for soft launch): 240 / 210 / 8
- standard: 180 / 150 / 5
- firm: 150 / 120 / 4
Hard floors in CODE: cooldown >= 120 s, min_play >= 90 s, <= 3.5 interstitials per 10 min of play.

When the governor will show an interstitial, the results button carries a small 'Reclamă înainte de rundă' tag. Flow: 0.8 s card 'Reclamă — Mulțumim că susții jocul gratuit.', ShowInterstitial, then start the requested run on any result.

- Grant: adfree_until = min(max(now, adfree_until) + 30 min, now + 60 min).
- 4 per day. Hidden when the stack is full.
- Surfaces:
  - results-panel link and pause-menu item 'Fără reclame 30 min'; when active it shows 'Fără reclame încă mm:ss' (non-interactive)
  - proactive card once per local day, on the results panel after today's 2nd interstitial, only if no revive card was shown at this game over
- Card: title 'PAUZĂ DE RECLAME'; value 'Privește o reclamă acum și ai 30 de minute fără reclame între runde. Reclamele opționale (cu recompensă) rămân la alegerea ta.'; buttons [Privește reclama] [Nu, mulțumesc].

backlog.title: Rescue placements: 'A doua suflare' once-per-run revive + '+1 Loc' wall-button extra slot
backlog.spec:
SHIP GATE: both placements return CanOffer false unless ctx.salvageActive (CORE-1). A test asserts this, so we never sell relief from the dead-ammo bug.

A) REVIVE 'A doua suflare'

Core: TitanGame.Revive(float pushBackFraction, float graceSeconds), valid only when IsOver and Lost is Wall, SlotsFull or Deadlock:
1. Lost = None.
2. Every line cannon with no visible color goes back into the deck at an rng index if its color still has cubes; otherwise it is dropped. Line[s] = null.
3. Distance = min(StartDistance, Distance + pushBackFraction*StartDistance).
4. stepTimer = -graceSeconds.
5. If every non-null tray cannon has no visible color, return them to the deck and redraw the 3 with bias 1.0 (fall back to random when no visible-color cannon is in the deck).
6. stuckTimer = 0.
7. Emit EventKind.Revived.
The ammo invariant is preserved.

Eligibility (Governor):
- revive_enabled, the global gate and !isDailyRanked
- revivesUsedThisRun < 1
- titansThisRun >= 1 OR progressFraction (cubes destroyed / spawn cubes on the current titan) >= 0.15
- offered only as the first thing after the loss

Flow:
1. 0.6 s freeze on the final frame with the loss banner.
2. Offer card instead of the results panel.
   - Title 'A DOUA SUFLARE'
   - Stake line 'Titanul #{n} · {pct}% distrus · Scor {score}'. NO record-gap line.
   - Value 'Tunurile adormite se întorc în pachet, titanul dă înapoi și primești tunuri cu culori vizibile.'
   - Buttons [Privește reclama și continuă] [Nu, mulțumesc] (same size)
   - Footer 'O singură dată pe rundă.'
3. First lifetime offer: the primary button reads 'Revino gratis' with no ad.
4. Completed: Revive(); fade back in over 0.5 s; no countdown (the grace period covers it).
5. ClosedEarly: back to the same card.
6. Failed or NotReady: spinner for up to 3 s. Then, if fallback grants this session < 1, grant it free with the toast 'Reclama nu s-a încărcat. Îți dăm revenirea oricum.' Otherwise show 'Nicio reclamă disponibilă acum' and disable accept.
7. Decline: straight to results, with the declined-revive flag set for the interstitial gate.

View: the titan stumbles back; sleeping cannons fly from the wall into the tray area and vanish into the deck.

Telemetry: offer params loss_reason, pct_destroyed, titans_this_run; revive_outcome {titans_after, seconds_after, new_best}.

Tuning: in Tools/Sim add a --revive mode where the bot revives once at its first loss (helpers stay OFF for every balance metric; this mode is ONLY for measuring revive value). Choose push-back from {0.25, 0.40, 0.60} as the smallest value where Smart gains >= 1 titan in >= 50% of revives. Record it.

B) EXTRA SLOT '+1 Loc'

killed.title: A5 'Pornește de la Titanul N' paid with an ad (with score credit)
killed.reason: It sells a way out of tedium the game itself creates, and it lets players buy score with ads, which pollutes personal bests. Free checkpoints at cycle starts (RET-1) cover the need.

killed.title: Interstitial at the BOSS break (from C6)
killed.reason: Titans chain continuously, so an ad there interrupts a run in progress. Nothing ad-related ever happens between titans.

killed.title: A3 'tap_full' trigger (a tray tap on a full line opens the +1 Loc ad card)
killed.reason: It turns a gameplay tap into an ad funnel and collides with the last-slot guard. The only entry point is the explicit wall button.

killed.title: Record-gap line ('Ești la X puncte de record!') on the revive card
killed.reason: It is loss-aversion pressure placed at the moment of sale. The fact belongs on the results screen (RET-2), not on the ad card.

killed.title: Banners (in gameplay or menus) at launch
killed.reason: About 1/10 of rewarded eCPM, and a high accidental-tap risk next to the bottom tray. At most a later results-screen-only test.

killed.title: A6 'x2 run XP' for now
killed.reason: There is no persistent meta sink yet. Doubling the score is worthless and would erode trust. At 15 a day it would also let ad-watchers out-progress everyone else.

killed.title: A4 'Tunuri proaspete' as a rewarded ad
killed.reason: After the salvage, conveyor and no-triple fixes the state is rare, it races the deadlock timer, and it would sell relief from our own random draw. If it returns, it returns as a free action.

killed.title: R6 'Lanț Perfect' second multiplier chain
killed.reason: It stacks on top of the near-miss, boss, clean and chain multipliers and makes the score unreadable. The feats are folded into CORE-5 as a grade with no extra multiplier.

killed.title: R5 108-species bestiary keyed on torso x head color, with a 35% color nudge
killed.reason: It collects palette swaps with no mechanical meaning, costs a lot (L complexity, hundreds of voxel heads) and is grindy.

killed.title: R2 as a separate onboarding system (harness-searched FTUE seeds, run-1 bias 0.9)
killed.reason: It is fragile because draws depend on tap timing, and it duplicates C10. The useful parts are merged into FTUE-1.

killed.title: R8 gates at titans 4/7/10
killed.reason: They are tied to the old monotonic build levels and duplicate checkpoints. Superseded by free checkpoints at cycle starts.

killed.title: R10 hub as a v1 feature
killed.reason: It depends on deferred systems, adds friction before play and becomes an ad-offer pile-up. The results panel plus the launch overlay serve as the hub for v1.

killed.title: Finalizing the official daily attempt when the app is killed
killed.reason: It punishes phone calls and OS kills. The attempt resumes from the last defeated titan instead.

killed.title: Pixel Flow-style streak-loss offer (losing a 10x streak with an offer on the fail screen) and any streak buy-back after a miss
killed.reason: It is a loss-aversion dark pattern, against our ethics line and the EU DSA/DFA direction.

killed.title: Any difficulty, draw or director logic that reads ad history, or lowering VisibleColorBias to sell help
killed.reason: It is the core ethics line. Bias is locked at 0.65 by a test, and all tuning is done with ad helpers off.

killed.title: The darker 'glove' tint on hand cubes
killed.reason: A luminance shift of one palette color can be read as another color. It is replaced by a shape cue (inset cube and edges).
